The tools that Western creators take for granted — Stripe for payments, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an automated delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-4. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

This isn't just about selling music; it's about reclaiming control over your digital commerce. In many countries, platforms like Gumroad charge exorbitant fees—up to 10% on every sale—while NOWPayments provides a leaner alternative at just 0.5%. When you consider 100 sales per month on a $97 product, this fee [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-selling-pdf-guides-without-14|COREMERCH guide to difference]] can retain an impressive $921 in your pocket. This is crucial for creators needing every dollar to reinvest in their craft.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The COREMERCH infrastructure is designed to be entirely sovereign. It combines GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for web hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto transaction processing. This architecture allows for automated delivery of digital products, ensuring customers receive their purchases instantly, all while you maintain full ownership of your data and transactions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Retain 921 more dollars with lower fees using NOWPayments instead of Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components of this solution include GitHub Pages for hosting your online store and Google Drive for delivering digital products. NOWPayments seamlessly integrates into this stack, enabling you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with no KYC requirements. This combination not only ensures your store is operational but also that it remains compliant and efficient, providing a frictionless experience for your customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling music online, first, choose the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access all the necessary blueprints and templates for deployment. Set up your GitHub Pages site, configure your backend logic using Google Apps Script, and integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Load your products and test the complete system to ensure everything works smoothly. This step-by-step approach will have your store live and operational in no time.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can utilize crypto payment processors like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept various cryptocurrencies with minimal fees, ensuring more profits for you. The infrastructure is designed to automate delivery and maintain full ownership of your data, making it a robust solution for digital creators.
Automate digital product delivery with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers.

If you're looking for a comprehensive solution to sell digital products without platform fees, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit contains everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your own sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
